items.title: The cartesianity condition for a comparison with the chaotic topology makes epsilon^* and R epsilon_* inverse equivalences onto the quasi-coherent objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion — the cartesianity condition (2) against a chaotic topology — for epsilon^* and R epsilon_* to be mutually quasi-inverse equivalences between QC(O) and the full subcategory of objects whose pushforward is quasi-coherent (statement lines 11607-11630). The proof (proof lines 11632-11675) reduces by fullness to the single identity R epsilon_*(epsilon^*M) = M on quasi-coherent objects, chooses a K-flat representative, computes via Leray and the restriction compatibility of sheafification, and identifies the outcome with the expression controlled by condition (2). H2: one reduction and one explicit computation, both written out.
